msg: There are 4 sets of mushroom people.  So you are always getting one of the same 4 color combos.  Meaning if, for example, red is with blue on the screen, then yellow is with green, that will stay the same.  It will never bee red with yellow, blue with green, etc.  For every set, each color is obviously better, as explained in the instructions.  What I observed is, if one color is producing a lot of mushrooms, stick with it, until it gets down to 1 or 2 when you select it.  After that, switch to the other.  There never seemed to be a gradual decrease in mushrooms for a single color consecutively.  So if Red had 8 mushrooms when I picked it, I would be picking Red over the other color at least a few more times until I switched.  Once Red was only producing 2, I would go to the other color.  And I would do that for all 4 sets of colors.  The hardest part is remembering which color to pick from the 4 sets, so whatever method works for memory purposes, use it.  I would say the 4 colors that were doing well over and over as I played, switching to saying another color when I had to, but it got confusing at times. Best of luck!!
